review_subject.description: All fourteen user-facing roadmap stages for the permanent Manifold and Rust B-rep/NURBS engine architecture

review_method.note: The reports are separate agent tasks in one system. They are design evidence, not external approval, legal advice, or a substitute for independent certificate verifiers.

reviewers.lens: primary synthesis and product feasibility red-team

reviewers.verdict: GO G0 only; NO-GO parallel G1-G3
GO G0 only; executable semantic seam missing
GO G0 then G1 sequentially; bounded capability matrices required

reviewers.lens: B-rep topology, snapshots, transactions, and identity
reviewers.verdict: GO G0 only; topology and identity ADRs block G2
GO strict gate order only; false Complete is a kill criterion

reviewers.lens: numerical robustness, degeneracies, sewing, and healing
reviewers.verdict: GO G0 only; qualification must precede every implementation gate

reviewers.lens: tessellation, scene ABI, rendering, and browser Worker
reviewers.verdict: SHIP G0 only; current v5 cannot carry B-rep scene identity

reviewers.lens: Rust/WASM runtime, security, supply chain, licensing, and MCP deployment
reviewers.verdict: GO G0 only; runtime and external release remain blocked

reviewers.lens: verification, qualification, and program delivery red-team
reviewers.verdict: GO limited G0 only; NO-GO G1+, activation, and rollout

findings_and_dispositions.resolution: SolidShellUse owns outer/cavity role; Shell has no canonical role; reverse ownership is derived

findings_and_dispositions.finding: Current/future worker protocol was named v3, v4, v5, and v6 in different specifications
findings_and_dispositions.resolution: Current protocol is v5 and the only planned incompatible successor is v6

findings_and_dispositions.finding: semanticHash and programHash were ambiguous aliases and topology/mesh preimages were incomplete
findings_and_dispositions.resolution: programHash is the sole semantic-program name; domain-separated TopologySnapshotId and MeshAssetId preimages are normative in the master plan

findings_and_dispositions.finding: Ten agent reviews could be mistaken for formal independent qualification evidence
findings_and_dispositions.resolution: The plan and this manifest explicitly classify them as role-separated design evidence, not organizationally independent approval or qualification

open_blockers: G0 contract pack is not complete
Executable SemanticProgram and Manifold differential adapter do not exist
Rust workspace and B-rep runtime do not exist
Independent certificate verifiers and frozen qualification corpora do not exist
Project-wide Rust licensing, inbound contribution, provenance, supervisor, and release policies are not approved
